data.exact_reserve_text: The new Managing Agent (AmTrust at Lloyd's Limited) was appointed on 1 April 2015 and, assisted by an independent claims consulting firm, instigated a review of all open claims as at Quarter 3. As a result, the claims reserves were strengthened materially, in particular on the 2013 and prior years. ... During the year there was net adverse claims development of GBP 18.1 million on the 2013 and prior years, GBP 3.4 million on the 2014 year and GBP 0.2 million on the 2015 year of account.

prior_year_events.event_name: Independent claims review and reserve strengthening
prior_year_events.impact_description: Independent review of open claims led to material strengthening of claims reserves, with the consulting actuary moving the ultimate claims position out by c.GBP 26.7m gross.
A number of large losses materialised, particularly under the Directors and Officers account, contributing to adverse development on older years.

prior_year_events.event_name: Late reporting on personal accident account
prior_year_events.impact_description: Late reporting on the personal accident account caused the incurred position to move by some GBP 3.2m.

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims reserves were strengthened in 2016 by GBP 27.071m (gross) predominantly driven by adverse development on the 2013 and prior years. The increase followed an independent review of open claims which identified significant increases in incurred claims (notably on professional indemnity, Directors & Officers and medical malpractice) and an additional large-loss loading. The main affected lines are the professional/third party liability portfolios, with secondary impacts from personal accident (Accident & Health).
raw_causal_phrases: claims reserves were strengthened materially, in particular on the 2013 and prior years
the significant increase in the incurred claims position on individual claims of GBP 16.5m gross and GBP 13.4m net
moving the ultimate claims position out by GBP 26.7m gross and GBP 18.6m net as a consequence
a large loss load accordingly as part of the ultimate claims position
materialisation of a number of large losses particularly under the directors and officers account
Late reporting on the personal accident account also caused the incurred position to move by some GBP 3.2m
net adverse claims development of GBP 18.1 million on the 2013 and prior years
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding 2015 comparative). Prior year development (gross) taken from Technical Provisions note row 'Changes for prior years' (gross GBP 27,071k). The document also quotes net adverse development figures (e.g. net GBP 18.1m on 2013 & prior) in the narrative; the gross figure has been used per instructions. Claims development triangle (gross) is available and was used to cross-check movements.
